name: pac-rag
description: A local, drag-and-drop knowledge base with a circuit-board chomper interface. Drop things in, they get indexed; ask questions or extract data in chat.
author: PAC&RAG
//: The server itself has no dependencies; electron and electron-builder are dev-only, for the desktop build. Written answers use plain HTTP to a llama.cpp / OpenAI-compatible / Anthropic endpoint configured in the app, so no SDK is needed
